chunks: They were descendants of one another; and God hears all and knows everything.

key_terms.بَعْضُهَا مِنْ بَعْضٍ: Some of them from others (indicating lineage)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the familial relationship between the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the spiritual and physical lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the prophetic chain directly to the Imams as the pure descendants of Abraham. The phrase 'some of them from others' underscores the continuity of divine guidance through specific, chosen progeny, reinforcing the concept of Imamate as an extension of prophethood. This highlights God's omniscience not only in their shared ancestry but also in their unique roles in guiding humanity.
